The '''''Logrus''''' was an [[ExcelStar]] [[Lone Scout-A]] used by [[Dhar Bullwin]] in an attempt to recover a power that he hoped to use to rule [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The ''Logrus'' was destroyed by a group of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] over [[Koda's World]]. Dhar Bullwin was able to escape in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] and land on the planet to continue harassing the scouts.
